questions.scenario: The diagram shows a food web in a grassland. The arrows show the direction in which energy flows.
questions.scenarioAf: Die diagram toon ’n voedselweb in ’n grasveld. Die pyltjies toon die rigting waarin energie vloei.

questions.q: Define an ecosystem.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n ekosisteem.
points: A community of organisms interacting with each other
and with their non-living (abiotic) environment
pointsAf: ’n Gemeenskap van organismes wat met mekaar
en met hul nielewende (abiotiese) omgewing in wisselwerking is

questions.q: Name the producer in the food web.
questions.qAf: Noem die produsent in die voedselweb.
points: grass
pointsAf: gras

questions.q: Name ONE herbivore in the food web.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN herbivoor in die voedselweb.
points: grasshopper, mouse or rabbit
pointsAf: sprinkaan, muis of haas

questions.q: Write down a food chain from the web that has FOUR organisms.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n voedselketting uit die web neer wat VIER organismes het.
points: grass → grasshopper → frog → snake
pointsAf: gras → sprinkaan → padda → slang

questions.q: Give the trophic level of the snake in your food chain.
questions.qAf: Gee die trofiese vlak van die slang in jou voedselketting.
points: tertiary consumer (fourth trophic level)
pointsAf: tersiêre verbruiker (vierde trofiese vlak)

questions.q: Predict what will happen to the number of frogs if all the birds are removed. Explain.
questions.qAf: Voorspel wat met die aantal paddas sal gebeur as al die voëls verwyder word. Verduidelik.
points: The number of frogs will increase
because more grasshoppers will be available for the frogs to eat
pointsAf: Die aantal paddas sal toeneem
omdat meer sprinkane vir die paddas beskikbaar sal wees om te eet

questions.q: The grass in the area holds 50 000 kJ of energy. Calculate how much of this energy reaches the frogs.
questions.qAf: Die gras in die gebied bevat 50 000 kJ energie. Bereken hoeveel van hierdie energie die paddas bereik.
points: grasshoppers: 10% of 50 000 = 5 000 kJ
frogs: 10% of 5 000 = 500 kJ
pointsAf: sprinkane: 10% van 50 000 = 5 000 kJ
paddas: 10% van 5 000 = 500 kJ

questions.q: Explain why food chains seldom have more than five trophic levels.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom voedselkettings selde meer as vyf trofiese vlakke het.
points: About 90% of the energy is lost at each level, mostly as heat through respiration
so too little energy is left to support another level
pointsAf: Ongeveer 90% van die energie gaan by elke vlak verlore, meestal as hitte deur respirasie
dus bly te min energie oor om nog ’n vlak te onderhou

questions.q: State the role of decomposers in this ecosystem.
questions.qAf: Noem die rol van ontbinders in hierdie ekosisteem.
points: They break down dead organisms and return nutrients to the soil
pointsAf: Hulle breek dooie organismes af en gee voedingstowwe terug aan die grond

sections.title: Support and transport systems in animals

questions.q: Name the THREE types of skeleton and give an example of an animal with each.
questions.qAf: Noem die DRIE soorte skelette en gee ’n voorbeeld van ’n dier met elk.
points: hydrostatic skeleton, e.g. earthworm
exoskeleton, e.g. insect or crab
endoskeleton, e.g. human or fish
pointsAf: hidrostatiese skelet, bv. erdwurm
eksoskelet, bv. insek of krap
endoskelet, bv. mens of vis

questions.q: State FOUR functions of the human skeleton.
questions.qAf: Noem VIER funksies van die menslike skelet.
points: support and shape
protection of organs
movement, with the muscles
making blood cells, or storing minerals
pointsAf: ondersteuning en vorm
beskerming van organe
beweging, saam met die spiere
maak van bloedselle, of berging van minerale

questions.q: State the function of each of the following parts of a synovial joint: (a) synovial fluid, (b) cartilage, (c) ligaments.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van elk van die volgende dele van ’n sinoviale gewrig: (a) sinoviale vloeistof, (b) kraakbeen, (c) ligamente.
points: (a) lubricates the joint and reduces friction
(b) absorbs shock and stops the bones rubbing together
(c) hold the bones of the joint together
pointsAf: (a) smeer die gewrig en verminder wrywing
(b) absorbeer skokke en keer dat die bene teen mekaar skuur
(c) hou die bene van die gewrig bymekaar

questions.q: Explain how the biceps and triceps work together to bend the arm at the elbow.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe die biseps en triseps saamwerk om die arm by die elmboog te buig.
points: The biceps contracts
while the triceps relaxes (they are an antagonistic pair)
pointsAf: Die biseps trek saam
terwyl die triseps ontspan (hulle is ’n antagonistiese paar)

questions.q: Describe osteoporosis and give ONE way to help prevent it.
questions.qAf: Beskryf osteoporose en gee EEN manier om dit te help voorkom.
points: The bones lose calcium and become porous and brittle, so they break easily
a diet rich in calcium and vitamin D, or regular exercise
pointsAf: Die bene verloor kalsium en word poreus en bros, sodat hulle maklik breek
’n dieet ryk aan kalsium en vitamien D, of gereelde oefening

questions.q: Name the chamber of the heart that pumps blood to the body.
questions.qAf: Noem die kamer van die hart wat bloed na die liggaam pomp.
points: left ventricle
pointsAf: linkerventrikel

questions.q: Explain why the wall of the left ventricle is thicker than the wall of the right ventricle.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die wand van die linkerventrikel dikker is as die wand van die regterventrikel.
points: The left ventricle pumps blood to the whole body
so it must produce a higher pressure than the right ventricle, which pumps only to the lungs
pointsAf: Die linkerventrikel pomp bloed na die hele liggaam
dus moet dit ’n hoër druk lewer as die regterventrikel, wat slegs na die longe pomp

questions.q: Name the blood vessel that carries blood away from the right ventricle.
questions.qAf: Noem die bloedvat wat bloed weg van die regterventrikel vervoer.
points: pulmonary artery
pointsAf: longslagaar

questions.q: What is meant by a double circulation?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met ’n dubbele bloedsomloop?
points: The blood passes through the heart twice
for each complete circuit of the body: once through the lungs (pulmonary) and once through the body (systemic)
pointsAf: Die bloed gaan twee keer deur die hart
vir elke volledige kringloop van die liggaam: een keer deur die longe (pulmonaal) en een keer deur die liggaam (sistemies)

questions.q: Tabulate THREE differences between arteries and veins.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer DRIE verskille tussen slagare en are.
points: Arteries: thick, muscular, elastic walls / Veins: thinner walls
Arteries: no valves (except at the heart) / Veins: valves along their length
Arteries: carry blood away from the heart / Veins: carry blood to the heart
pointsAf: Slagare: dik, gespierde, elastiese wande / Are: dunner wande
Slagare: geen kleppe nie (behalwe by die hart) / Are: kleppe oor hul lengte
Slagare: vervoer bloed weg van die hart / Are: vervoer bloed na die hart

questions.q: Name the blood vessels that supply the heart muscle itself with blood.
questions.qAf: Noem die bloedvate wat die hartspier self van bloed voorsien.
points: coronary arteries
pointsAf: koronêre slagare

questions.q: State the function of capillaries.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van kapillêre.
points: the exchange of substances between the blood and the tissues
pointsAf: die uitruil van stowwe tussen die bloed en die weefsels

questions.scenario: Four learners measured their heart rates at rest and immediately after five minutes of exercise.
questions.scenarioAf: Vier leerders het hul harttempo in rus en onmiddellik ná vyf minute se oefening gemeet.

questions.q: Calculate the average heart rate at rest.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde harttempo in rus.
points: = 71,25 beats per minute
pointsAf: = 71,25 slae per minuut

questions.q: Calculate the average heart rate after exercise.
questions.qAf: Bereken die gemiddelde harttempo ná oefening.
points: 483 ÷ 4 = 120,75 beats per minute
pointsAf: 483 ÷ 4 = 120,75 slae per minuut

questions.q: Explain why the heart rate increases during exercise.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die harttempo tydens oefening toeneem.
points: The muscles need more oxygen and glucose
for more cellular respiration to release energy
and the extra carbon dioxide must be removed faster
pointsAf: Die spiere het meer suurstof en glukose nodig
vir meer sellulêre respirasie om energie vry te stel
en die ekstra koolstofdioksied moet vinniger verwyder word

questions.q: A normal blood pressure reading is 120/80 mmHg. What do the two numbers represent?
questions.qAf: ’n Normale bloeddruklesing is 120/80 mmHg. Wat stel die twee getalle voor?
points: 120: systolic pressure, when the ventricles contract
80: diastolic pressure, when the ventricles relax
pointsAf: 120: sistoliese druk, wanneer die ventrikels saamtrek
80: diastoliese druk, wanneer die ventrikels ontspan

questions.q: Give TWO lifestyle factors that increase the risk of heart disease.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE leefstylfaktore wat die risiko van hartsiektes verhoog.
points: smoking
a diet high in fat and salt, lack of exercise, obesity or stress
pointsAf: rook
’n dieet hoog in vet en sout, ’n gebrek aan oefening, vetsug of stres

questions.q: Name the pigment in red blood cells that carries oxygen.
questions.qAf: Noem die pigment in rooibloedselle wat suurstof vervoer.
points: haemoglobin
pointsAf: hemoglobien

questions.q: State the function of platelets.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van bloedplaatjies.
points: blood clotting
pointsAf: bloedstolling

sections.title: Ecosystems, biodiversity and the history of life
sections.titleAf: Ekosisteme, biodiversiteit en die geskiedenis van lewe

questions.q: Give TWO abiotic factors that affect the organisms in an ecosystem.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE abiotiese faktore wat die organismes in ’n ekosisteem beïnvloed.
points: temperature, or light
water, soil or wind
pointsAf: temperatuur, of lig
water, grond of wind

questions.q: Describe how carbon moves from the atmosphere through living organisms and back to the atmosphere.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe koolstof van die atmosfeer deur lewende organismes en terug na die atmosfeer beweeg.
points: Plants take in carbon dioxide during photosynthesis
the carbon becomes part of glucose and other organic compounds
animals obtain the carbon when they eat plants
respiration, decomposition and burning release carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere
pointsAf: Plante neem koolstofdioksied tydens fotosintese op
die koolstof word deel van glukose en ander organiese verbindings
diere verkry die koolstof wanneer hulle plante eet
respirasie, ontbinding en verbranding stel koolstofdioksied terug in die atmosfeer vry

questions.q: Name TWO biomes found in South Africa.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE biome wat in Suid-Afrika voorkom.
points: fynbos, or savanna
grassland, Nama Karoo, Succulent Karoo, forest, thicket or desert
pointsAf: fynbos, of savanne
grasveld, Nama-Karoo, Sukkulente Karoo, woud, ruigte of woestyn

questions.q: Describe TWO characteristics of the fynbos biome.
questions.qAf: Beskryf TWEE kenmerke van die fynbosbioom.
points: Winter rainfall and hot, dry summers
small, hard-leaved shrubs that are adapted to fire
pointsAf: Winterreën en warm, droë somers
klein struike met harde blare wat by vuur aangepas is

questions.q: Explain why decomposers are important in nutrient cycles.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ontbinders belangrik is in voedingstofsiklusse.
points: They break down dead plants and animals and waste
and return nutrients to the soil, where plants can use them again
pointsAf: Hulle breek dooie plante en diere en afval af
en gee voedingstowwe terug aan die grond, waar plante dit weer kan gebruik

questions.q: Define biodiversity.
questions.qAf: Definieer biodiversiteit.
points: The variety of living organisms
in an area, including genetic, species and ecosystem diversity
pointsAf: Die verskeidenheid lewende organismes
in ’n gebied, insluitend genetiese, spesie- en ekosisteemdiversiteit

questions.scenario: The scientific name of the lion is Panthera leo.
questions.scenarioAf: Die wetenskaplike naam van die leeu is Panthera leo.

questions.q: Name the genus of the lion.
questions.qAf: Noem die genus van die leeu.
points: Panthera
pointsAf: Panthera

questions.q: Write down the species name of the lion.
questions.qAf: Skryf die spesienaam van die leeu neer.
points: leo
pointsAf: leo

questions.q: Give TWO rules for writing a scientific name.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE reëls vir die skryf van ’n wetenskaplike naam.
points: The genus name starts with a capital letter and the species name with a small letter
it is printed in italics, or each name is underlined separately when handwritten
pointsAf: Die genusnaam begin met ’n hoofletter en die spesienaam met ’n kleinletter
dit word in kursief gedruk, of elke naam word afsonderlik onderstreep as dit met die hand geskryf word

questions.q:
Use the key to identify animals A to D.
A: has six legs and wings, no backbone
B: has eight legs, no backbone
C: has a backbone and feathers
D: has a backbone and fins, no feathers
Key:
1a Backbone present … go to 2
1b No backbone … go to 3
2a Feathers present … bird
2b No feathers, fins present … fish
3a Six legs … insect
3b Eight legs … arachnid

Gebruik die sleutel om diere A tot D te identifiseer.
A: het ses pote en vlerke, geen ruggraat nie
B: het agt pote, geen ruggraat nie
C: het ’n ruggraat en vere
D: het ’n ruggraat en vinne, geen vere nie

1a Ruggraat teenwoordig … gaan na 2
1b Geen ruggraat nie … gaan na 3
2a Vere teenwoordig … voël
2b Geen vere nie, vinne teenwoordig … vis
3a Ses pote … insek
3b Agt pote … araknied
points: A: insect
B: arachnid
C: bird
D: fish
pointsAf: A: insek
B: araknied
C: voël

questions.q: Name TWO kingdoms, other than Animalia, whose members are eukaryotes.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE koninkryke, behalwe Animalia, waarvan die lede eukariote is.
points: Plantae
Fungi, or Protista
pointsAf: Plantae
Fungi, or Protista

questions.q: Explain why South Africa is regarded as a country with very high biodiversity.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom Suid-Afrika as ’n land met baie hoë biodiversiteit beskou word.
points: It has a very large number of species in a small area (e.g. the Cape Floral Kingdom)
and many endemic species found nowhere else
pointsAf: Dit het ’n baie groot aantal spesies in ’n klein gebied (bv. die Kaapse Blommeryk)
en baie endemiese spesies wat nêrens anders voorkom nie

questions.q: What was the Cambrian explosion?
questions.qAf: Wat was die Kambriese ontploffing?
points: The rapid appearance and diversification
of most of the major animal groups about 540 million years ago
pointsAf: Die vinnige verskyning en diversifikasie
van die meeste van die hoofgroepe diere ongeveer 540 miljoen jaar gelede

questions.q: Describe how a fossil forms in sedimentary rock.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe ’n fossiel in sedimentêre gesteente vorm.
points: The organism dies and is quickly buried in sediment
the soft parts decay
the hard parts are slowly replaced by minerals
the layers of sediment are compressed and harden into rock
pointsAf: Die organisme sterf en word vinnig in sediment begrawe
die sagte dele ontbind
die harde dele word stadig deur minerale vervang
die sedimentlae word saamgepers en verhard tot gesteente

questions.q: Distinguish between relative dating and absolute (radiometric) dating of fossils.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen relatiewe datering en absolute (radiometriese) datering van fossiele.
points: Relative dating: the position of the fossil in the rock layers shows whether it is older or younger than others (deeper layers are older)
Radiometric dating: the decay of radioactive isotopes gives the age in years
pointsAf: Relatiewe datering: die posisie van die fossiel in die gesteentelae toon of dit ouer of jonger as ander is (dieper lae is ouer)
Radiometriese datering: die verval van radioaktiewe isotope gee die ouderdom in jare

questions.q: Carbon-14 has a half-life of 5 730 years. A bone contains 25% of its original carbon-14. Calculate the age of the bone.
questions.qAf: Koolstof-14 het ’n halfleeftyd van 5 730 jaar. ’n Been bevat 25% van sy oorspronklike koolstof-14. Bereken die ouderdom van die been.
points: 100% → 50% → 25% is two half-lives
pointsAf: 100% → 50% → 25% is twee halfleeftye

questions.q: Give TWO possible causes of mass extinctions.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE moontlike oorsake van massa-uitsterwings.
points: an asteroid impact
large volcanic eruptions or sudden climate change
pointsAf: ’n asteroïde-impak
groot vulkaniese uitbarstings of skielike klimaatsverandering

questions.q: Name ONE important fossil site in South Africa.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN belangrike fossielterrein in Suid-Afrika.
points: the Cradle of Humankind, the Karoo or Barberton
pointsAf: die Wieg van die Mensdom, die Karoo of Barberton

questions.q: Why do some scientists say that a "sixth extinction" is happening now?
questions.qAf: Waarom sê sommige wetenskaplikes dat ’n "sesde uitsterwing" nou plaasvind?
points: Species are disappearing very quickly because of human activities
pointsAf: Spesies verdwyn baie vinnig as gevolg van menslike aktiwiteite

questions.q:
Describe the path of blood through the heart, lungs and body, and explain how the structure of arteries, veins and capillaries suits their functions.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf die roete van bloed deur die hart, longe en liggaam, en verduidelik hoe die struktuur van slagare, are en kapillêre by hul funksies aangepas is.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: Deoxygenated blood enters the right atrium through the venae cavae
It passes through the tricuspid valve into the right ventricle
The right ventricle contracts and pushes blood through a semilunar valve into the pulmonary artery
In the lungs the blood takes up oxygen and gives off carbon dioxide
Oxygenated blood returns through the pulmonary veins to the left atrium
It passes through the bicuspid (mitral) valve into the left ventricle
The left ventricle contracts and pushes blood into the aorta
The aorta and its branches carry blood to all parts of the body
The valves prevent blood from flowing backwards
The blood passes through the heart twice in one circuit (double circulation)
Arteries have thick, muscular and elastic walls
to withstand the high pressure of blood from the heart
Veins have thin walls and a wide lumen
and valves that stop the backflow of blood at low pressure
Capillary walls are only one cell thick
so substances diffuse quickly between the blood and the tissues
There are very many capillaries, which gives a large surface area
pointsAf: Suurstofarm bloed kom die regteratrium deur die venae cavae binne
Dit gaan deur die trikuspidale klep na die regterventrikel
Die regterventrikel trek saam en stoot bloed deur ’n halfmaanklep na die longslagaar
In die longe neem die bloed suurstof op en gee koolstofdioksied af
Suurstofryke bloed keer deur die longare terug na die linkeratrium
Dit gaan deur die bikuspidale (mitrale) klep na die linkerventrikel
Die linkerventrikel trek saam en stoot bloed na die aorta
Die aorta en sy vertakkings vervoer bloed na alle dele van die liggaam
Die kleppe verhoed dat bloed terugvloei
Die bloed gaan twee keer in een kringloop deur die hart (dubbele bloedsomloop)
Slagare het dik, gespierde en elastiese wande
om die hoë druk van bloed uit die hart te weerstaan
Are het dun wande en ’n wye lumen
en kleppe wat die terugvloei van bloed by lae druk keer
Kapillêre wande is slegs een sel dik
dus diffundeer stowwe vinnig tussen die bloed en die weefsels
Daar is baie kapillêre, wat ’n groot oppervlakte gee

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about the path of blood and the blood vessels; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): the path of blood is described in the correct order
Comprehensive (1): at least 7/10 for the path of blood and 5/7 for the blood vessels
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor die roete van bloed en die bloedvate; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): die roete van bloed word in die korrekte volgorde beskryf
Omvattend (1): ten minste 7/10 vir die roete van bloed en 5/7 vir die bloedvate
